title: Israel's Stubbornness

questions.question: Hear this, O house of Jacob, who are called by the name of Israel, and who came from the waters of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 48:1 (ESV): "and who came from the waters of Judah,"

questions.question: Who swear by the name of the LORD and confess the God of Israel, but not in truth or what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 48:1 (ESV): "but not in truth or right."

questions.question: For they call themselves after the holy city, and stay themselves on the God of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 48:2 (ESV): "and stay themselves on the God of Israel;"

questions.question: Because I knew that you are obstinate, and your neck is an iron sinew and your forehead what?
For my name's sake I defer my anger; for the sake of my praise I restrain it for you, that I may not cut you what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 48:9 (ESV): "that I may not cut you off."

questions.question: Behold, I have refined you, but not as silver; I have tried you in the furnace of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 48:10 (ESV): "tried you in the furnace of affliction."

questions.question: For my own sake, for my own sake, I do it, for how should my name be profaned? My glory I will not give to whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 48:11 (ESV): "My glory I will not give to another."

questions.question: Listen to me, O Jacob, and Israel, whom I called! I am he; I am the first, and I am the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 48:12 (ESV): "I am the first, and I am the last."

questions.question: My hand laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand spread out the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 48:13 (ESV): "my right hand spread out the heavens;"

questions.question: Thus says the LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: "I am the LORD your God, who teaches you to profit, who leads you in the way you should what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 48:17 (ESV): "who leads you in the way you should go."

questions.question: Oh that you had paid attention to my commandments! Then your peace would have been like a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 48:18 (ESV): "Then your peace would have been like a river,"

questions.question: And your righteousness like the waves of the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 48:18 (ESV): "and your righteousness like the waves of the sea;"

questions.question: Your offspring would have been like the sand, and your descendants like its grains; their name would never be cut off or destroyed from before whom?
Go out from Babylon, flee from Chaldea, declare this with a shout of joy, proclaim it, send it out to the end of the earth; say, "The LORD has redeemed his servant whom?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 48:20 (ESV): "The LORD has redeemed his servant Jacob!"

questions.question: "There is no peace," says the LORD, "for the whom?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 48:22 (ESV): "There is no peace," says the LORD, "for the wicked."

key_verse_text: Thus says the LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: "I am the LORD your God, who teaches you to profit, who leads you in the way you should go."
